Name: David Smith
Biography: David Smith has been the Member for Bean since 2019. Before entering politics, he worked as a lawyer and political advisor. He has served on several parliamentary committees, focusing on social policy and regional development. Smith is committed to improving education and healthcare services in his electorate.

Name: Alicia Payne
Biography: Alicia Payne, elected in 2019, represents the Division of Canberra. Before entering politics, she worked in the community sector, focusing on social justice and human rights. Payne has been involved in various roles, including policy development and advocacy for marginalized groups. She holds a Bachelor of Arts from the Australian National University.

Name: Andrew Leigh
Biography: Andrew Leigh is an economist and author who has been the Member of Parliament for Fenner since 2016. He holds a PhD from Harvard University and has served as Assistant Minister for Competition, Charities and Treasury. Leigh is known for his work on social mobility, inequality, and behavioral economics.

Name: David Coleman
Biography: David Coleman has been the Member for Banks since 2013. Before entering politics, he was a lawyer and worked in the media industry. Coleman served as the Minister for Immigration, Citizenship, Migrant Services and Multicultural Affairs from 2018 to 2022. He is known for his focus on community engagement and infrastructure development within his electorate.

Name: Linda Burney
Biography: Linda Burney is a prominent Australian politician and the current Member of Parliament for the Division of Barton, NSW. She has served as the Minister for Indigenous Australians since 2022. Burney's career spans significant roles in education, social justice, and politics, including being the first Aboriginal person to serve in the NSW Parliament and later in the Australian House of Representatives.
